we can predict group social engagement level using audio and video information, that we can achieve better performance by using both modalities together and that we can predict social engagement levels of a group of people by looking only at one of them.

(a) the fusion of audio and visual modalities is beneficial for the prediction of social engagement levels, and (b) the prediction of social group engagement levels is possible with an accuracy of around 70% for multiparty conversations, which is comparable to the accuracy achieved in the prediction of dyadic social engagement.

1) the proposed fusion approach for social group engagement level recognition is effective, 2) visual cues are more informative than acoustic cues, 3) social group engagement is a more complex concept than dyadic social engagement, and 4) the proposed fusion model can be used for real time applications.
